scripts.bump:patch: npm version patch -m 'chore: bump version to %s' && git push && git push --tags && npm publish
scripts.bump:minor: npm version minor -m 'chore: bump version to %s' && git push && git push --tags && npm publish
scripts.bump:major: npm version major -m 'chore: bump version to %s' && git push && git push --tags && npm publish
scripts.bump:patch:rc: npm version prepatch --preid rc -m 'chore: bump candidate to %s' && git push && git push --tags && npm publish --tag beta
scripts.bump:minor:rc: npm version preminor --preid rc -m 'chore: bump candidate to %s' && git push && git push --tags && npm publish --tag beta
scripts.bump:major:rc: npm version premajor --preid rc -m 'chore: bump candidate to %s' && git push && git push --tags && npm publish --tag beta
scripts.bump:rc: npm version prerelease --preid rc -m 'chore: bump candidate to %s' && git push && git push --tags && npm publish --tag beta
